mechanism: Bumetanide-induced volume depletion and reduced renal perfusion may decrease mycophenolate renal clearance and increase exposure, while loop diuretics can elevate mycophenolate levels through altered pharmacokinetics.
action: Monitor renal function, mycophenolate trough levels, and signs of mycophenolate toxicity (GI upset, bone marrow suppression); ensure adequate hydration and consider mycophenolate dose adjustment if bumetanide therapy intensifies.
